description: Source code for a Markdown report generator class used in Playwright testing framework, including methods for summarizing test results and writing reports to a file.

classes.name: MarkdownReporter
classes.description: A reporter class for generating Markdown formatted test reports in Playwright.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter outputs to standard IO.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of the test suite, sets config and suite references.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Records a fatal error encountered during testing.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Generates and writes the final report after test execution.

methods.name: publishReport
methods.description: Writes the report string to a file.

methods.name: _generateSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of test outcomes for reporting.

methods.name: _printTestList
methods.description: Formats and appends a list of tests to the report lines.
